```sql
SELECT 
    SUM(fct_orders.net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_date 
    ON analytics.fct_orders.order_date_local = analytics.dim_date.date_day
WHERE 
    analytics.dim_date.fiscal_year = 2026
    AND fct_orders.status != 'cancelled';
```

```sql
SELECT 
    o.region,
    SUM(o.net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders o
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_day = o.order_date_local
WHERE 
    d.calendar_month = 3 
    AND d.calendar_year = 2026
GROUP BY 
    o.region;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    o.channel,
    SUM(o.net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders o
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_day = o.order_date_local
WHERE 
    d.calendar_year = 2025
    AND o.status != 'cancelled'
GROUP BY 
    o.channel
ORDER BY 
    o.channel;
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM analytics.dim_customers
WHERE first_order_on >= '2025-02-01' 
  AND first_order_on < '2026-02-01';
```

```sql
SELECT 
    o.region,
    SUM(o.net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue,
    SUM(ol.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders o
JOIN 
    analytics.fct_order_lines ol 
    ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_date d 
    ON d.date_day = o.order_date_local
WHERE 
    d.calendar_year = 2025
    AND o.status != 'cancelled'
GROUP BY 
    o.region
ORDER BY 
    o.region;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    SUM(ol.net_amount_eur) AS net_revenue
FROM 
    analytics.fct_order_lines ol
JOIN 
    analytics.fct_orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_products p ON ol.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_date d ON o.order_date_local = d.date_day
WHERE 
    p.category = 'tents' 
    AND d.calendar_year = 2025
    AND o.status != 'cancelled';
```

```sql
SELECT 
    SUM(f.net_revenue_eur) AS total_revenue
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders f
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_date d ON f.order_date_local = d.date_day
WHERE 
    d.calendar_year = 2025
    AND f.status != 'cancelled';
```

```sql
SELECT 
    o.region,
    AVG(o.net_revenue_eur) / COUNT(o.order_id) AS average_order_value
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders o
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_day = o.order_date_local
WHERE 
    d.calendar_month = 3 AND d.calendar_year = 2026
    AND o.status != 'cancelled'
GROUP BY 
    o.region;
```
